tool: Codex CLI 0.162.1 (codex exec, built-in image_generation tool) on the maintainer's Mac mini
style: Flat isometric vector illustration, clean shapes, soft navy-to-teal gradient background, accent colors coral and warm yellow, gentle soft shadows, 16:9 wide composition, no text, no letters, no logos, no watermarks, no people, no human faces, no characters from existing games or brands.

images.docs/images/cover-models.webp: A tidy display of generic low-poly 3D game props on a floating hex tile: a wooden crate, a barrel, a stylized pine tree, a rock, and a small treasure chest, plus a faint wireframe grid.
images.docs/images/cover-textures.webp: A grid of square material swatches floating in space like tiles: brick, mossy stone, wood planks, rusted metal, sand and grass, with one swatch applied to a sphere.
images.docs/images/cover-audio.webp: Stylized sound design scene: a waveform ribbon flowing out of a small speaker, a microphone, floating audio cassette shapes and musical note particles.
images.docs/images/cover-vfx.webp: Magical particle effects showcase on a dark stage: a swirling fire vortex, an ice crystal burst, and a lightning arc, glowing particles and sparks, no characters.
images.docs/images/cover-abilities.webp: Top-down view of a game arena floor with spell targeting UI: a glowing aim arrow, a circular area-of-effect ring, and a cooldown ability bar of abstract rune icons, no characters.
images.docs/images/cover-animation.webp: An abstract mannequin made of simple geometric blocks (no face) shown in several overlapping motion poses like an onion-skin run cycle, with a keyframe timeline ribbon below.
images.docs/images/cover-tools.webp: A creative toolbox desk: floating editor windows showing a tile map, a node graph, a pixel-art canvas showing an abstract gem and an audio waveform, with a pencil, a brush and a wrench. No mushrooms. (Regenerated once to remove a mushroom sprite that could read as another game's IP.)
images.docs/images/entry-kenney.webp: A cheerful assortment of generic flat game asset sprites laid out on a sheet: platform tiles, coins, gems, hearts, simple vehicles and UI buttons, all original generic shapes.
images.docs/images/entry-opengameart.webp: A community gallery wall of framed generic game art: a pixel-art landscape, a 3D low-poly house, a music note frame and a tileset frame, with a heart icon for sharing.
images.docs/images/entry-freesound.webp: A huge library shelf of glowing sound clips shaped like small boxes, each with a tiny waveform, connected by flowing sound waves.
images.docs/images/entry-ambientcg.webp: Scanned PBR material spheres in a row: rough concrete, polished marble, bark, fabric and metal, each with subtle separate map layers peeling off behind it.
images.docs/images/entry-tiled.webp: An orthogonal tile map editor concept: a top-down village map assembled from square tiles, with a tile palette panel and layer stack floating beside it.
images.docs/images/entry-lmms.webp: A music sequencer concept: a piano roll with colorful note blocks, a row of step-sequencer pads and knobs, floating in space.
images.docs/images/entry-godot-demos.webp: A collection of small floating demo scenes on islands: a 2D platformer level, a 3D physics playground with cubes, and a UI menu panel, all generic shapes.
images.docs/images/entry-controller-prompts.web: A neat sheet of generic game input prompt icons: four round face buttons each marked only with one, two, three or four small dots (absolutely no triangle, circle, cross or square symbols, no letters), a directional pad, analog sticks, shoulder triggers, keyboard keys and a mouse, all generic, no brand shapes or brand colors. (Regenerated once: the first try drew console-brand face-button symbols.)
images.docs/images/cover-ui.webp: A floating game menu interface: generic buttons, sliders, health and mana bars, inventory grid and a minimap frame, all abstract shapes.
images.docs/images/cover-fonts.webp: Large stylized letterform shapes made of pixel blocks and smooth curves floating like signage, abstract glyph shapes only, no readable words.
images.docs/images/cover-physics.webp: A physics playground: stacked boxes tumbling, a ball bouncing on a ramp, a swinging pendulum and a chain, with motion trails.
